message.reasoning: We saw alert: checkout p95 latency above 800ms. recent deploys shows none. Health check shows unhealthy: checkout. Logs show warnings about waiting for db connection pool 2/2 busy. config_changes shows config change: db_pool_size changed from 20 to 2 at 02:20. That likely caused connection pool starvation leading to high latency. The change was to set db_pool_size to 2. That is likely root cause. We changed back to 20. After change, health is true. So root cause: bad_config (db_pool_size too low). We should finish with cause "bad_config", root_cause_service "checkout". Provide summary.

function.name: finish
function.arguments: {"cause":"bad_config","root_cause_service":"checkout","summary":"The checkout service experienced high latency due to the db_pool_size being reduced to 2, causing the pool to become fully occupied and blocking requests. Restored the pool size to the original 20, resolving the latency issue. All services are now healthy."}
